correctness.rationale: For a 3D orthotope W(u)=Σa_i|u_i|. Haar U has each marginal uniform[-1,1], E W(U)=S/2. Given U, Haar V in U-perpendicular circle satisfies E(|V_j||U)=(2/π)sqrt(1-U_j²). The independent diagonal moment computes E|U_jV_j|=(2/π)∫_0^1 t sqrt(1−t²)dt=2/(3π), while for i≠j circle conditioning gives (4/π²)(1/2)∫_{−1}^1(1−t²)dt=8/(3π²). The mixed width moment follows by bilinearity. Subtract S²/4 to obtain A Q+B(S²−Q). A<0<B, A−B<0; solve root tau=−B/(A−B)=0.348201061933... . At fixed S, Q>=S²/3 uniquely for equal a,b,c and Q<S² for positive lengths with rod approach. The exact cube sign is >0 by π<22/7, while rod covariance tends A S²<0. Continuous positive lengths realize the whole interval. Independent SymPy checked both Haar integrals and tau expression.
